$comment: Per-TASK event journal. Append-only log of new IDs / terms / error codes / i18n keys introduced by this TASK. Source-of-truth for shared/*.md rebuild — when CI (or sdlc-shared-rebuild.sh) regenerates shared/, it reads every TASK's journal.json and aggregates. Each TASK writes only to its OWN journal under .sdlc/tasks/{TASK-ID}/journal.json — there is no cross-TASK contention because each TASK has a different file path.
_taskId_doc: Owning TASK. Must equal the parent directory name (.sdlc/tasks/TASK-NNN/journal.json → taskId = TASK-NNN). Validated by sdlc-journal-write.sh.
_entries_doc: Append-only array of events. Each entry MUST have: type (string, see types below), phase (which SDLC phase produced this event: ba|sa|uiux|sd|fe|be|test|abandon|...), addedAt (ISO8601). Beyond those three required fields, the rest of the fields depend on type. Never mutate or remove existing entries — only append. Deprecation is itself an event ('id_deprecated' or 'error_code_deprecated'), not a mutation of the original 'id_added' entry.

_entry_types_doc.id_added: New global ID introduced (ENTITY/MOD/FUNC/PATTERN/API/TBL/COMP/PAGE/LAYOUT). Required: id, name, filePath. Optional: section.
_entry_types_doc.id_deprecated: Existing ID marked DEPRECATED (e.g. when TASK abandoned). Required: id, reason. Optional: deprecatedAt (defaults to addedAt).
_entry_types_doc.term_added: Business glossary term. Required: term, definition. Optional: filePath, section.
_entry_types_doc.error_code_added: Error code under shared/error-codes.md. Required: code (ERR-DOMAIN-NNN), alias, httpStatus, message. Optional: thrownByApis (string[]), domain (extracted from code if absent).
_entry_types_doc.error_code_deprecated: Error code marked DEPRECATED. Required: code, reason.
_entry_types_doc.error_domain_added: First-time DOMAIN registration (ERR-PAYMENT, ERR-NOTIFY, ...). Required: domain, description.
_entry_types_doc.i18n_key_added: i18n string key. Required: key, defaultText. Optional: compId, namespace.
_entry_types_doc.external_binding: Pencil node ↔ COMP/PAGE binding. Required: external (e.g. pencil:node:abc123), internal (e.g. COMP-005). Optional: kind (component|page|variant|variable).
_entry_types_doc.convention_violation_waived: Approved deviation from a convention. Required: convention (api|db|code|i18n|branch), reason, approvedBy.
_entry_types_doc.parameter_added: Operational parameter (env var / feature flag / config key / shared limit / API URL / secret ref) introduced by this TASK. Required: paramName, paramKind (env|flag|limit|url|secret), value (string|number|bool, or 'secret-ref:<path>' for secrets). Optional: paramType (string|number|boolean|secret|url) — note: NOT 'type' to avoid collision with the entry's outer type field — scope (dev|staging|prod|all), required (true|false), ownerService (fe|be|both), description, rollout (for flags: internal|beta|ga|deprecated), unit (for limits), prodUrl/stagingUrl/devUrl (for url kind), vaultPath (for secret kind).
_entry_types_doc.parameter_modified: Existing parameter changed (value, scope, default, etc.). Required: paramName, field, oldValue, newValue, reason. Modifying a param introduced by another TASK requires Rule 6 cross-TASK approval.
_entry_types_doc.parameter_deprecated: Parameter marked DEPRECATED. Required: paramName, reason. Optional: successor (new param name replacing this one).
